description: Returns the current state of a quote or transfer by its id, with the fees, the transaction hash and the explorer link once sent. States: quoted (waiting for the signature), submitting and sent (on its way; ask again after a few seconds), confirmed (done), failed (error says why) and expired (not signed in time; request a new quote). Use it to follow up after submit_signatures or to see whether a quote is still open. It cannot start, change or cancel anything; use quote_send or quote_swap to start. Read-only. Returns { summary, transfer }. An unknown or malformed id, or one older than 30 days, fails with "Transfer not found".

transferId.description: The id gasrescue returned as transfer.id from quote_send or quote_swap: 24 lowercase hex characters, e.g. "b39f46001a5680455091152d". Not a transaction hash and not an id of another service.
